name: Wesley Corey
summary: Wesley Corey was among the Dunwich onlookers who took turns with the telescope during the standoff on Sentinel Hill, reporting that Armitage was preparing the sprayer for the final confrontation.
description: Wesley Corey, who had taken the telescope, cried out that Armitage was adjusting the sprayer which Rice held, and that something must be about to happen.
